summary.text: Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) IPO is a book build issue of ₹360.76 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 1.01 crore shares aggregating to ₹192.00 crores and offer for sale of 88.35 lakh shares aggregating to ₹168.76 crores.

Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) IPO opens for subscription on Nov 26, 2026 and closes on Nov 30, 2026. The allotment for the Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) IPO is expected to be finalized on Dec 1, 2026. Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Dec 3, 2026.

Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) IPO is set issue price band at ₹181 to ₹191 per share. The lot size for an application is 78 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,898 (78 shares) (based on upper price).
Equirus Capital Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.
Refer to Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) IPO RHP for detailed Information.

about.text: Incorporated in 2003, Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) Ltd. is a food and beverage services company engaged in providing premium catering services and operating casual dining restaurants and cloud kitchens. Headquartered in Mumbai, Foodlink caters to weddings, social celebrations, corporate events and other large-scale gatherings. Its restaurant portfolio includes brands such as China Bistro, India Bistro, Glocal and Art of Dum. The company also operates through its international subsidiary in the UAE, expanding its presence in the global food and hospitality industry.
Banquets and Integrated F&B Services (Jade Luxury Banquets).

As of September 30, 2026, we have operations in India, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom and Malaysia, and have catered for events in countries including Switzerland, Turkey, Italy, Spain, United Arab Emirates, France, Oman, Qatar, Egypt, Jordan, Maldives, Thailand, Nigeria, United Kingdom and Malaysia.

The company operate 28 Casual Dining Restaurants & Cloud Kitchens. These are located in India and United Arab Emirates with 15 Casual Dining Restaurants & Cloud Kitchens spread across two cities in India at 10 different locations, and 13 Casual Dining Restaurants & Cloud Kitchens in United Arab Emirates spread across two cities at seven different locations. The company have five centralised kitchens in India, located in Mumbai (Maharashtra), Ahmedabad (Gujarat), Mohali (Punjab), Hyderabad (Telangana), and New Delhi.
As of September 30, 2026, the company employed 1,481 people.

India’s largest organized, ultra-luxury and luxury catering (weddings, meetings, incentives, conferences, and event (“MICE”), sports, personal celebration catering and banquets) company in terms of Fiscal 2024 revenue amongst our peers in India, with a focus on casual dining, banquets and integrated F&B services.
Ability to deliver innovative and quality experiences leading to diversified portfolio of marquee customers.
Strategically located centralized kitchens with streamlined supply chain and well-established processes.
Experienced promoter and professional management team with domain knowledge.

business.text: Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) Limited is a prominent player in the catering and hospitality industry, offering a wide range of food and beverage services across domestic and international markets. The company follows an integrated business model built around three major business verticals:
Events Catering: Specialised catering services for weddings, corporate gatherings, MICE events, sporting events, and private celebrations.
Casual Dining Restaurants and Cloud Kitchens: Operations covering dine-in restaurants and delivery-focused cloud kitchen formats.
Banquets and Integrated F&B Services: Premium banquet venues and comprehensive food and beverage solutions offered under the Jade Luxury Banquets brand.

As of December 31, 2024, the company had an operational presence in India and the United Arab Emirates (UAE). In addition, it has delivered catering services for events across several international destinations, including Switzerland, Turkey, Italy, Spain, France, Oman, Qatar, Egypt, Jordan, the Maldives, Thailand, and Nigeria.

As disclosed in its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP), Foodlink operated 30 casual dining restaurant and cloud kitchen units. Of these, 18 units were located across 13 locations in two Indian cities, while the remaining 12 units operated across six locations in Dubai.

To support its catering and restaurant operations, the company has established five centralised kitchens in key Indian cities: Mumbai (Maharashtra), Ahmedabad (Gujarat), Mohali (Punjab), Hyderabad (Telangana), and New Delhi. These facilities form an important part of its food preparation and distribution network.
As of December 31, 2024, Foodlink had a total workforce of 1,235 employees supporting its business operations and service delivery.

Leadership in Premium Catering: Ranked as India's largest organised ultra-luxury and luxury catering company by revenue for Fiscal 2024 among its Indian peers, with services covering weddings, MICE events, sports events, personal celebrations, and banquets.
Strong Customer Relationships: Focus on delivering distinctive, innovative, and high-quality food and hospitality experiences, supported by a diversified portfolio of reputed customers.

Efficient Kitchen and Supply Chain Network: Strategically positioned centralised kitchens, established operating procedures, and streamlined supply chain capabilities that support consistent service delivery.
International Market Presence: Geographically diversified operations and catering experience across multiple domestic and overseas markets.
Experienced Leadership: Backed by promoters and a professional management team with extensive industry experience and expertise in the catering and hospitality sector.
